moves.label: Trade: Marvin Bagley III, Josh Jackson, Trey Lyles, Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye and others
moves.description: Marvin Bagley III was acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for Josh Jackson, Trey Lyles, a Least Favorable 2023 2nd round pick and a 2024 2nd round pick (SAC own). Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye, the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic and a TPE were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for Serge Ibaka, the draft rights to David Michineau and cash. Serge Ibaka, a Least Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (POR own) and cash were acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Donte DiVincenzo, Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye and the draft rights to Ilkan Karaman. Donte DiVincenzo, Josh Jackson, Trey Lyles, the draft rights to Ilkan Karaman, the draft rights to David Michineau, a 2024 2nd round pick (SAC own) and a TPE were acquired by the Sacramento Kings in exchange for Marvin Bagley III, the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic, a 2024 2nd round pick (POR own) and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Jae Crowder, George Hill, Serge Ibaka, Jordan Nwora, Kevin Durant and others
moves.description: Jae Crowder was acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for George Hill, Serge Ibaka, Jordan Nwora, a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (MIL own), a 2025 2nd round pick (IND own), a 2028 2nd round pick (MIL own) and a 2029 2nd round pick (MIL own). Kevin Durant and T.J. Warren were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Mikal Bridges, Jae Crowder, Cameron Johnson, a 2023 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2025 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2027 1st round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2028 1st round picks and a 2029 1st round pick (PHX own). George Hill, Serge Ibaka, Jordan Nwora, a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (MIL own), a 2025 2nd round pick (IND own) and cash were acquired by the Indiana Pacers in exchange for the draft rights to Juan Vaulet. Mikal Bridges, Cameron Johnson, the draft rights to Juan Vaulet, a 2023 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2025 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2027 1st round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2028 1st round picks, a 2028 2nd round pick (MIL own), a 2029 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2029 2nd round pick (MIL own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for Kevin Durant, T.J. Warren and cash.

moves.label: Trade: MarJon Beauchamp, Kevin Porter, Jr.
moves.description: MarJon Beauchamp was acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers from the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for: Kevin Porter, Jr. and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Patrick Baldwin, Jr., Delon Wright, Hugo Besson, Jericho Sims, Mathias Lessort and others
moves.description: Patrick Baldwin, Jr. and cash were acquired by the San Antonio Spurs in exchange for a 2026 2nd round pick (UTH own). Delon Wright, the draft rights to Hugo Besson, cash and a TPE were acquired by the New York Knicks in exchange for Jericho Sims and the draft rights to Mathias Lessort. Kyle Kuzma, Jericho Sims, a More Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a 2026 2nd round pick (UTH own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for A.J. Johnson, Khris Middleton, Delon Wright, the draft rights to Hugo Besson, a Swap 2028 1st round picks and cash. A.J. Johnson, Khris Middleton, the draft rights to Mathias Lessort, a Swap 2028 1st round picks, cash and a TPE were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for Patrick Baldwin, Jr., Kyle Kuzma, a More Favorable 2025 2nd round pick and a TPE.

moves.description: Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis were acquired by the Miami Heat from the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for: Tyler Herro, Kasparas Jakucionis, Jaime Jaquez, Jr., Kel'el Ware, the draft rights to Nate Ament, a Swap 2030 1st round picks, a 2031 1st round pick (MIA own), a 2033 1st round pick (MIA own), a 2033 2nd round pick (MIA own) and multiple TPEs.

moves.label: Trade: John Collins, Santi Aldama, Marcus Sasser, Tarik Biberovic, A.J. Johnson and others
moves.description: A conditional 2030 2nd round pick (DET own) and a TPE were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for John Collins and cash. Santi Aldama, Marcus Sasser and the draft rights to Tarik Biberovic were acquired by the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for A.J. Johnson, Khris Middleton, a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own) and a 2033 2nd round pick (DAL own). Khris Middleton, a 2033 2nd round pick (DAL own) and a TPE were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for D'Angelo Russell, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAL own), a Swap 2032 2nd round picks, a 2033 2nd round pick (WAS own) and a TPE. Caris LeVert, a 2027 2nd round pick (MIL own) and cash were acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Gary Harris and Taurean Prince. A.J. Johnson, D'Angelo Russell, Isaiah Stewart II, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAL own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own), a Swap 2032 2nd round picks and a 2033 2nd round pick (WAS own) were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Santi Aldama, the draft rights to Tarik Biberovic, a 2029 2nd round pick (DET own), a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own) and a 2032 2nd round pick (DET own). John Collins, Gary Harris, Taurean Prince, a Least Favorable 2027 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (DET own), a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own), a 2032 2nd round pick (DET own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for Caris LeVert, Marcus Sasser, Isaiah Stewart II, a Least Favorable 2027 2nd round pick, a 2027 2nd round pick (MIL own) and a conditional 2030 2nd round pick (DET own).
